scope: single end slice, disclosed fixture; mechanics and robot claims separate
overall_rule: PASS only if all applicable required checks pass; unresolved or missing measurements produce BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE, never pass. N/A allowed only by declared mechanics-only scope.

separation.rule: No mechanically active path through springs/tets/skin/attachments/constraints connects slice to remainder; independent release/probe motion persists >=1 s after blade withdrawal. At-rest touching is permitted, cohesive coupling is not. No teleport, timer/depth-only release or slice fixture support.
separation.probe_design: bounded contact probe must overcome board friction if needed; log its work so forcing a remaining bond to break does not fake completion

thickness.rule: measure released material along cut normal at >=5 interior sample locations after stated settling; each must meet tolerance; log taper/range and material strain. Define end-surface curvature contribution.

remainder_motion.rule: best-fit bulk material motion in board frame; report deformation separately and fixture reactions, do not confuse constrained pose with gentle stabilization

knife_slip.rule: hand-relative transform during cut; all original grasp conditions also apply unchanged; prescribed blade gets N/A and no grasp claim

loads.rule: log peak/RMS/impulse and durations; evaluate only verified axes. No force safety claim from torque-only data. Robot/real-cut acceptance blocked until limits defined; isolated synthetic mechanism study may report unvalidated loads, not overall robot success

blade_hand_clearance.rule: zero blade contact with either hand; subtract geometry/pose uncertainty from clearance; right-hand handle contact allowed; retain actuator/joint constraints

numerics.rule: finite states; no invalid inverted elements if applicable, no runaway volume collapse, no unexplained energy injection; account external prescribed-blade/fixture work and damage dissipation; fixture must not constrain slice
numerics.status: energy and volume limits require model-specific pre-run definition

convergence.rule: compare half timestep and refined mesh with physical parameters/patch area scaled consistently; do not compare by retuning material after each resolution

resources.rule: unchanged startup/runtime watchdog, common lock and bounded exit; incomplete stages are inconclusive; record process-tree RAM and global VRAM, step-time distribution, real-time factor and cooking time

negative_controls: Stopped blade => no clock-driven damage; any stored-energy fracture must follow a disclosed law.
Interrupted cut and reset restore state without hidden damage.
Released piece has collision contact without persistent cross-cut damping.
freeze_gate: define load, volume and energy bounds
review thresholds before execution; do not mutate frozen grasp file
